grounding.states: large eggs dropped into boiling water: 12 to 13 minutes gives fully hard-boiled eggs
grounding.from: Healthline says 12 to 13 minutes gives fully hard-boiled eggs

grounding.states: large eggs dropped into boiling water: 10 minutes gives eggs mostly cooked through but slightly soft in the center
grounding.from: At 10 minutes, the eggs are mostly cooked through but slightly soft in the center.

grounding.states: large eggs dropped into boiling water: past about 14 to 15 minutes the eggs turn rubbery or dry
grounding.from: Past about 14–15 minutes the eggs turn rubbery or dry.

value.answer: For large eggs dropped into boiling water, 12 to 13 minutes gets a fully set yolk. 10 minutes is mostly set but a bit soft in the middle. Go past 14 or 15 and the whites get rubbery and the yolk dry. Smaller eggs need a little less time.
